name: h2-longmemeval-cost
assumptions: The sizes are the two baseline configs as COUNT=1 counts them: 500 questions of the cleaned S split, one condition each, three seeds, store Mem0; the judge makes one call per session, as upstream's evaluate_qa.py does, and HTTP retries are not counted.
Tokens are pi's own estimate, characters over four (pi-coding-agent estimateTokens); the high estimate counts three characters per token (token_scale 4/3) for JSON, ids and non-English text.

The fixture cassettes (B5's, on the oracle subset, store Mem0) fix one memory read and one answer per session; the high estimate lets a live model make two more reads, each repeating the session so far and a read as large as the first.

Memory per read on the full set: the question's own text as the query, the shared pipeline's top 20 (C2 over every turn; C5 over the turns preset medium admits at B5's read time, so the turns its 90-day ttl hides are not shown: research/results/h2-longmemeval-ttl.json). A live model writes its own query, which may match more or fewer turns.

Tokens per item are the fixture reads', moved by the difference between the S split's characters per shown item and the fixture's, over four; the reader prompt and the judge's prompt move from the fixture questions' size to the S split's mean the same way.
Answers and the judge's verdict are as long as the scripted ones; a live answer may be longer, and it is in the judge's prompt, which the high estimate's token scale covers only in part.

The runner asks for thinking off (packages/runner/src/conditions.ts); what pi-ai 1.3.0 then sends each candidate is as research/results/h1-cost.json states it. Reasoning output tokens per answer call, where off is honoured: 0 (low) and 1,024 (high); where it is ignored: 256 (low, a floor assumed, not measured) and 4,096 (high). None for the judge (GPT-4o has no reasoning). Each candidate reports what 1,000 reasoning tokens per answer call cost.

The candidates are H1's (research/configs/h1-cost.json), since decision sheet item 1, the three models, is open; the judge is the paper's model, gpt-4o-2024-08-06, through OpenRouter's seeded chat completions.
No prompt caching, batch discount or provider minimum is assumed; prices are list prices from the catalogue, not a quote, and a price the script flags as a likely catalogue anomaly is used as listed.
